Rows all contain 'we' and stay. Not fixed here: S0407L02's own text (نَكونُ where its seed has نَكونَ, and 'we are' where its seed says 'to set') belongs to items 6 and 10.

legos.why: 'quiet' is the prompt for هادئ (S0034L02) and for هادِئينَ (plural, here). L34: 'one English prompt with two target answers: FIRST try to unify to one target form; only if the target language genuinely needs both, put one inside a larger LEGO, and that LEGO must make clear WHY it differs'. The plural grows to the verb that makes it plural, in its own seed: 'remain quiet | نَبْقى هادِئينَ' (6 syllables). 'we remain | نَبْقى' (S0403L02) is swapped in front so the small piece is taught first (L13) — STRUCTURAL reorder, needs Kai's go and may be refused while learners are on these LEGOs; the fix stands without it. All 9 rows are rebuilt: they said 'هُمْ هادِئينَ', which is also wrong Arabic (it needs هادِئونَ there).
